title: Plasma-nm should do a better job at displaying errors regrading your network
line: When signing in to an enterprise Wi-Fi fails, the password dialog no longer blames only the password: it points to the authentication method, CA certificate and domain and has a Configure button.
explanation: When 802.1X (enterprise) authentication fails, NetworkManager asks plasma-nm for new secrets, and the password dialog always said "Incorrect password … Please try again." The real cause is often a wrong EAP method, CA certificate or domain (the reporter's case), which only shows up in the journal, so users keep retyping a correct password. The dialog now says authentication failed and names those settings for 802.1X retries, and adds a Configure… button that cancels the request and opens that connection in System Settings.

commits.message:
kded: explain failed enterprise authentication in the password dialog

When 802.1X authentication failed, the dialog asking again for secrets
said the password was wrong, even when the cause was a wrong EAP method,
CA certificate or domain. It now names those too and offers Configure.

BUG: 459713

media.caption: Enterprise (PEAP) Wi-Fi retry: the dialog only says the password is incorrect
Same retry: it names the method, certificate and domain and offers Configure…
Configure… closes the dialog and opens that connection's settings

reviews.text: Rewording the 802.1X password retry dialog to mention authentication method, CA certificate, and domain and adding a Configure… button is a clean UX improvement in itself. However, it does not sufficiently address Bug 459713, which asks plasma-nm to display better, more informative network errors rather than only generic prompts; this patch never touches plasma-nm's actual error notifications (e.g., kded/notification.cpp still emits cryptic NetworkManager reasons like 'Authorization supplicant failed' with no guidance or Configure action, and failures that do not re-request secrets remain untouched). Launching systemsettings via KIO::CommandLauncherJob also lacks a job UI delegate.
changes: Extend the fix to also improve plasma-nm's actual network failure reporting (for example, making cryptic authentication/supplicant/configuration failure notifications in kded/notification.cpp clearer and adding a Configure… action there too) rather than closing the broad error-display wishlist on a single static wording change in PasswordDialog.
Attach a KNotificationJobUiDelegate (with AutoHandlingEnabled) to KIO::CommandLauncherJob in PasswordDialog so launch errors are handled and Wayland activation works cleanly.
